scope: Actual TLS 1.3 mutual handshake on local socketpairs, pinned client certificate identity, paired with existing cryptographic JWT policy. No HTTP listener or native execution.

verified_boundaries.transport: TLS 1.3 server-side SSLSocket, OpenSSL-verified client chain, CERT_REQUIRED, negotiated hepta-agent/1 ALPN
verified_boundaries.device_identity: SHA256 of actual TLS leaf DER matched to immutable, private, pinned administrator enrollment
verified_boundaries.enrollment: Private exact-byte SHA256 / owner check / no symlink / size <=64KiB / unique certificate, tenant/device tuple and host aliases / <=30 day freshness
verified_boundaries.isolation_proof: Two mandatory trusted callbacks checked on every use: live device revocation and independent signed runtime/OS tenant isolation; both are TEST STUBS in this suite, not production proof
verified_boundaries.tenant_pair: Two distinct real CA-verified client certs plus actual RS256 signed RFC9068 access tokens mapped through existing GatewayPolicy
negative_cases: Valid CA but unenrolled leaf denied
Incorrect ALPN / no required client certificate policy denied
Raw DER, claimed dict or plain socket cannot mint device
Revocation and signed-isolation callback errors/nonboolean deny
Wrong-tenant signed token cannot select the other verified TLS device
Old write call ID remains reserved after certificate and generation rotation

still_blocked: Real OAuth 2.1 authorization/login/consent server and verified issuer discovery
Real revocation and consent persistence with fail-closed availability
Independent signed runtime manifest verification and OS tenant UID/mount/namespace isolation
Externally provisioned CA, client certificates and automatic key rotation/revocation
Authenticated outbound agent protocol, live public HTTPS streamable MCP ingress and end-to-end pen testing
Public ChatGPT app security review, rollout and commercial billing
